a.lede: A memo circulated earlier this year reportedly claimed that China’s Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO.
a.title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo

b.lede: Nvidia has announced that it is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company. b.title: Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy
